sources.notes: National open-data catalogue with API and machine-readable formats.
INE Retail Trade Indices table 75808; official JSON API. Provides demand/growth signals only; supply and price remain unknown until another source supplies evidence.
EU open-data portal states data is available free of charge and can be used for business.
Official TED public procurement Search API. Used only as product-level demand evidence from active procurement notices; not proof of profitability or buyer intent beyond the published notice.
Singapore government open-data APIs are publicly accessible; production rate limits and dataset-specific terms must be respected.
Japan Statistics Dashboard WebAPI from the Statistics Bureau. No registration required; JSON/CSV/XML supported. Published services must display the official API credit and respect rate/access rules.

Official UN Comtrade public preview API. No account or subscription key required; intentionally limited to targeted preview queries. Used for trade-flow evidence, not retail-price or profitability claims.
